summary: Frontend visual/branding audit of the Pulse cyan port on Service Desk (/service-desk), Engineer App (/svc/engineer) and Supplier Case portal (/supplier/case/:token). All three routes render (no blank pages, no lazy-load failures, no JS errors beyond harmless third-party CSP violations). HOWEVER the brand port is INCOMPLETE: it only swapped hardcoded hex literals — it did NOT touch Tailwind color utility classes (`bg-blue-*`, `text-blue-*`, `bg-violet-*`, `text-violet-*`, `bg-purple-*`, `text-purple-*`, `bg-indigo-*`, `text-indigo-*`), so old GymAxis navy (#2563EB) and violet/purple (#7c3aed, #a855f7, #9333ea) still render on all three surfaces. Runtime computed-style scan on the Service Desk page found 15+ elements resolving to rgb(37,99,235) (Tailwind blue-600 = navy #2563EB) and rgb(124,58,237) (Tailwind violet-600 = #7c3aed). Body font resolves to 'Manrope' (from index.css line 371 `body { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; }`), NOT the required 'Proxima Nova' primary from brand guidelines.

issues: Body font resolves to 'Manrope, sans-serif' (index.css line 371). Brand guideline requires 'Proxima Nova' primary with 'Maax Rounded' display fallback. Only the marketing pages (PulseLandingPage/PulsePricingPage/LearnMorePage) and Navbar explicitly set Proxima Nova; the operator app bodies inherit Manrope. Update `body { font-family }` in index.css so Proxima Nova is used app-wide (currently Manrope wins for /service-desk, /svc/engineer, /supplier/case).

`_serviceops.css` var declarations (--svc-gradient-from, --svc-gradient-to, --svc-accent, --svc-violet) are not present at :root — computed style at documentElement returns empty strings. If those vars are supposed to drive the Service Ops palette they must be either scoped to a wrapper that's guaranteed to be an ancestor of ServiceDeskPage, or hoisted to :root/globally. Otherwise the Tailwind palette (which is untouched) wins.

critical_code_review_comments: Brand port used find/replace on hex literals only. Because most of this codebase is Tailwind-first, that pass missed the vast majority of visible color usages (`bg-blue-600`, `text-purple-500`, etc.). A proper brand pass needs to either (a) redefine tailwind's `blue`/`violet`/`purple`/`indigo` palettes in tailwind.config.js to Pulse cyan/teal, or (b) sweep the Tailwind utility usages.
index.css sets body font to Manrope which overrides brand Proxima Nova on every operator/portal route. Marketing pages only escape because they inline `style={{fontFamily}}`.
SupplierCasePage.js is 874 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting the case-detail, schedule-visit, and history sections into dedicated components while doing the branding sweep.

success_rate.frontend: Render 100% (3/3 routes load without errors) · Branding compliance ~30% (hex-literal usages ported, Tailwind utility usages NOT ported)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login redirects service-desk operators straight to /service-desk. Owner account cannot enter the full /svc/engineer app (subscription gate). Supplier portal path is /supplier/case/:token; without a real token you only see 'Case Not Found' shell. To visualize the actual case-detail palette (which is where the purple `bg-purple-*` code lives) you must seed a real supplier-portal token or mint one via the API. The three routes DO render without JS errors (only harmless third-party CSP warnings for emergent-main.js/posthog/cloudflare). The real failure is that Tailwind utility classes (`bg-blue-*`, `bg-violet-*`, `bg-purple-*`, `text-blue-*`, `text-purple-*`, `text-indigo-*`) were never swept during the port — runtime computed-style scan on /service-desk found 15+ elements still at rgb(37,99,235)/rgb(124,58,237).
rca of the issue: Root cause: the Pulse brand port replaced hardcoded hex color literals (`#2563eb`→`#0891b2`, `#8b5cf6`→`#0e7490`, etc.) but did NOT modify Tailwind color utility class usages, which is how ~90% of the Service Desk, Engineer app, Supplier Case and Partner Engineer pages actually apply color. Reproduction: log in as owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123!, hit /service-desk — the KPI tile icon chips (Total Customers/Active/Pending/Archived) render with light-blue and light-violet backgrounds; open DevTools and inspect any of those chips — you'll see the Tailwind class `bg-blue-50 text-blue-600` resolving to `rgb(37, 99, 235)` = old GymAxis navy. Same story on SupplierCasePage (schedule-visit card is purple), PartnerEngineerActivate (purple CTAs), PartnerDashboard (purple CTAs), EngineerEquipment (blue-600 CTAs). Mitigation options: (1) redefine `blue`/`violet`/`purple`/`indigo` in tailwind.config.js theme.extend to Pulse cyan/teal values so all existing Tailwind classes flip automatically; OR (2) sweep the codebase and replace the Tailwind color utilities with `cyan`/`sky`/`teal` equivalents or custom `pulse-*` tokens. Additionally, update body font in index.css to Proxima Nova primary so brand typography actually takes effect app-wide.
